:::{#exm-congruence}
#### Clock arithmetic

- $17$ is [congruent to $5$ modulo $12$](#def-congruence), $17 \equiv 5 \pmod{12}$,
  because $17 - 5 = 12$
  and $12 \mid 12$.
  On a 12-hour clock,
  hour 17 is 5 o'clock.
- $17 \not\equiv 4 \pmod{12}$,
  because $17 - 4 = 13$
  and $12 \nmid 13$.

<!-- no-figure: two single congruences -->
